newsitem.title: UK: UK's Major says Nov jobless figures "magnificent".
newsitem.headline: UK's Major says Nov jobless figures "magnificent".

text.p: British Prime Minister John Major described as "magnificent" figures for November unemployment which showed the number of jobless had fallen below two million for the first time in six years.
"They are not good, they are magnificent," Major told Ulster Unionist member of parliament Ken Maginnis during a visit to a school in Dungannon, some 40 miles (65) outside Belfast.
The Office for National Statistics said unemployment fell to 6.9 percent in November from 7.2 percent in October.

The number of people out of work dropped by 95,800, the biggest fall since 1971, to 1.93 million. It was the first time the jobless total had been below the psychologically important two million since February 1991.
